hypotheses.title: Missing encoder noise filter leaves high derivative noise
hypotheses.mechanism: No CONF2 write leaves FILT=0 with 12 LSB RMS noise; 1 kHz differencing creates 373 deg/s RMS velocity noise driving current and 4 Hz hunting, never restored because STATUS.RST not checked.

evidence.quote: the noise filter is off; output noise 12 LSB RMS (table 31-2)
evidence.detail: Baseline controller never writes CONF2, so encoder stays at power default with filter off and maximum noise.
Any reset including brown-out returns device to same filter-off state, requiring per-cycle restore.

evidence.quote: Velocity noise at 1 kHz rises from 78 °/s RMS to 373 °/s RMS
evidence.detail: Loss of FILT 3 to FILT 0 raises velocity noise almost 5x, explaining motor drive and audible hunting.

evidence.quote: FILT = 3 (CONF2 = 0x03) is the recommended starting point. It reduces
evidence.detail: Manual recommends FILT 3 as starting point for 1 kHz joint loop with 3-10 Hz crossover.
Clip s1-baseline-7 shows 4.03 Hz peak 27.3 dB above floor, rms 7.88 px and p2p 31 px on forearm object 0, sustained hunting not slow drift.
Frames 144 min -16.1 px, 148 max +15.0 px show same forearm oscillating about elbow while markers stay fixed.

hypotheses.title: Wide host filtering and PD gains sustain noise hunting
hypotheses.mechanism: ANGLE_LPF 200 Hz and DERIV_LPF 30 Hz with KP 3.2 pass broadband encoder noise to torque; with 2 ms delay this sustains 4 Hz limit cycle.

evidence.quote: 373 °/s RMS of noise into the current command.
evidence.detail: Even moderate noise is multiplied by derivative gain into current command, heating motor and exciting resonance.

evidence.quote: the read latency of 2 ms (page 12) for a host that polls once
evidence.detail: 2 ms read delay plus filter lag must stay small vs phase margin; wide host filters pass noise while adding delay.

evidence.detail: Strong filtering is not free: large tau adds lag at hunting frequency and can itself destabilize the loop.
Spectral peaks at 4.03, 4.31, 3.74 Hz clustered around 4 Hz crossover suggest delay plus gain sensitive limit cycle on elbow.

safetyPreconditions: Keep hands and tools clear of elbow and forearm travel during live tests
Stop motion and hold last command if magnet field flags show invalid angle
Count encoder resets in logs and inspect supply decoupling if count rises

approachHints: Write CONF2 to set encoder filter FILT to 3 and restore it same cycle whenever RST is seen
Read STATUS together with angle every cycle and hold last command while field flags show invalid
Keep encoder filter between 2 and 4 to cut noise without adding large phase lag at 4 hertz
Tune proportional and derivative gains with host low pass filters for quick settle and small steady error
